notes.title: Final Beta Update
notes.content:
Hey Handy Harry's fans, I've got some very exciting news! This is the final update to H4S before the 1.0 Full Version release update coming later this year. I know a lot of you are dying for some new content and while this maybe isn't the update you were hoping for, I can assure you that the largest content update is right around the corner. I will be announcing the final release date very soon!

Here's what's new in this version:

Overhauled player animations!
Glow sticks can now be picked back up (or stolen).
Massively improved network efficiency and stability.
Added TV head hat. Thanks to jobo the hobo for the suggestion!
Added surprised face skin.
Improved flashlight ambient lighting.
Improved hell pit door animation
Added option in settings to reduce light flickering.


I'd also like to take this moment to apologise for the lack of updates during the last few months. I have been hard at work on other exciting projects such as Space Gourmet: Delivery and some other secret projects. But I assure you I haven't forgotten about H4S. I hope the upcoming launch update as you excited as I am. More details coming soon! Thanks for the patience and support,

Ben.

notes.title: Career Update - Beta 3.0
notes.content:
It's finally here! The long awaited Career Update!

Congratulations! You've just been officially hired by Handy Harry's Haunted House Services Incorporated! Jump into the career mode and see where this new job will take you! I'm sure nothing terrible will happen...

The H4S story mode features 20 thrilling levels with progressively larger and more complex layouts as well as 4 different ghost types. The new ghost AI replaces the old randomised AI behaviour with new individually programmed ghosts. Each with their own unique behaviour and attack patterns.

This is H4S' most ambitious update.
And here's what's in it:

What's New?
Story Mode

20 Hand made levels!
Boss-battles!
Up to 4 players!
Handy Harry is Here!

4 New Ghost Types! Each with their own behaviours and attack patterns.

Spectre: Run away!
Slasher: Run and hide, stay out of sight!
Summoner: Nobody is safe!
Spider: Don't get stuck in it's spider webs!

Logo Cap Hat.
Dynamite Stick Flashlight.
Player Level & XP: Earn XP by completing jobs and level up!
What's Better?
Maps now display a layout of the level.
Maps no longer display completed repairs.
Huge performance improvements = more FPS.
Repair radar now shows direction and distance of nearest repair.
PvP ghost now has it's own ghost type: The Haunted Handyman
Redesigned the Main Menu.
Certain level decorations now hint to what kind of ghost is in the level.
Improved AI teleportation method for improved reliability.
Tuned the pixelation to look better.
Door handles
Gun flashlight now makes a shooting sound.
Added a sound effect when picking up a battery.
What's Fixed?
Fixed players respawning still webbed.
Fixed players being able to join games running a different version of the game.
Fixed several AI path finding glitches.
Other minor improvements and bug fixes.


I hope you will all enjoy this new update. I know it's been way to long since the last large content update, but believe it will have been worth the wait. There are still many things planned on the horizon, including Steam Deck support amongst other things!

Nothing in the game is final, so if you have any suggestions please don't be afraid to get in touch with me via the discord: https://discord.gg/fJWwnSS
I'd love to hear your ideas, if you experience any bugs or if there are things you don't quite like.

As always:
Enjoy, have fun and get spooked!
Ben.

notes.title: Update Beta 2.4
notes.content:
Merry Spookmas fellow handymen!
I hope everyone is having a great holiday season!
This update is just a little patch adding a Xmas theme to H4S. There is unfortunately no new content.
I know this is probably quite disappointing, and for that, I'm sorry.

I promise I'm still working on the next update, which should be not only the biggest, but also the most game changing update that has ever been released for H4S. I unfortunately haven't had the time to work on it as much I I'd like. However progress has been made towards the new ghost AI (I think you guys are gonna like it!). But I can't say exactly when the update will be ready by.

Here's a small list of what's planned for the next update:

Missions and level progression.
Ghost AI overhaul #2. With specialised ghost AI. Different ghost types with different behaviours and attack patterns.
Better room variation.
Dropping batteries for other players.
Steamdeck compatibility,
And MUCH more!

(*these mechanics are not final and may be changed or removed)

As you can probably imagine, these changes are not easy, and will take time to develop and test before they are ready for release. I hope you all can bare with me, I know you're excited for new content and I promise I will deliver!

But most importantly, I want to thank everyone for an amazing year! I never imagined H4S would be as loved as it is, let alone still be played and enjoyed by so many people, two and a half years after it's early access release! It's crazy, and it's all thanks to the support and encouragement from you guys. I wish you all an amazing end of 2022 and an even more amazing start to 2023!!!

See you all for Update 3.0! ;)

Enjoy, have fun and I wish you all a spooktacular spookmas!
Ben.

notes.title: Update Beta 2.2
notes.content:
Greetings fellow handymen, old and new!
I can't believe it's been 2 years since the early access release of H4S!
Thank you to everyone who's supported this silly indie game. It was only ever supposed to be a game that I quickly made to have some fun with friends on a Covid-19 locked-down weekend. And it somehow snowballed into a game that is (apparently) beloved by so many people.

I know what you're probably thinking... "Geez when is this game ever going to be finished?" And to be honest, the reason I haven't just thrown a few updates together and called it done is because of you guys! Nobody motivates me to work on this game more than the people who play it. And for that reason I want to make H4S the best damn $5 you ever spend!

As for you H4S veterans out there, I don't want you to be bored either. I want you to keep coming back for more! Many of you have indeed been playing this game since the early Alpha days. And I think you need a new challenge! 

With that said, let's jump into the new update...
And here's what's in it:

What's New?
s̎͏͈͈̝͎̰̱͓̫p̣͓͉̭̃̐͝i̞̙̼̲̫̳ͮͯ̋ͪ̕ͅd͂̂҉̯̦̼̫̳͖͍̫e̵̬͕̝̰̞̳͐ͩ̚r̎̔̇̏҉̞̹̝͉̬    
Giant spider webs! Careful, they are very sticky!
Steam trading cards! 13 new trading cards, 8 awesome profile backgrounds and 10 amazing emoji!
Escape timer! Flipped the master switch? Get to the elevator quickly before you run out of time!
Upgraded ghost AI! Hide, turn off your flashlight, stand really still and you just might survive.

Ghost has a new vision system. Try to stay out of it's field of view.
Turning off your flashlight will give you a greater chance of not getting caught.
Ghost will walk slower and will search more carefully if it senses you near it.
Ghost will no longer detect players that are very close unless they have their flashlight on.

New leaderboards! Most deaths, wins/loses, batteries collected and more!
Added birthday theme.
Cake flashlight.
Added a bug report button to the main menu.

What's Better?
Viewmodel flashlight is not rendered on a different layer and is not affected by FOV settings.
Players that fall off the map are now teleported into the map instead of falling for ever.
Ghosts (PVP mode included) are teleported away once a revive has finished to prevent spawn camping.
Ghost will teleport further away from players to prevent sudden unexpected death.
Ghosts can no longer teleport to the first room outside the elevator.
Buy button in the shop now acts an a "equip" button once the item is purchased.
Optimised ghost stunning. This should hopefully prevent certain crashes from happening.
You can now change your input device for VOIP from the settings menu.

What's Fixed?
Fixed joining players seeing doors that the host player did not.
Fixed door variations not applying to client players.
Fixed player color not applying to spectated players.
Fixed bug where ghostlings path-finding would break and then they would not despawn.
Fixed PVP ghost vision detecting the ghost player themselves.
Minor UI tweaks.
Other minor bugfixes.


Thank you again to everyone who has supported the game in the last 2 years! It's been a fantastic experience and I'm excited to keep this train rolling! I still have plenty of updates planed ahead.

As always, things in the game are not final, so if you have any suggestions please don't be afraid to get in touch with me via the discord: https://discord.gg/fJWwnSS
I'd love to hear your ideas, if you experience any bugs or if there are things you don't quite like.

As always:
Enjoy, have fun and get spooked!
Ben.

notes.title: Update Beta 2.0
notes.content:
Greetings fellow handymen, old and new!
Boy do I have some news for you all, including a graphics overhaul, in game map and 3D skins.
This update is so significant that we've skipped update 1.9.
Skip to the bottom of this post for the full list of changes.

New rendering method: 
https://i.ibb.co/m9kQy11/Render-Comparison.gif
This new hybrid pixelation rendering method means smoother graphics and eliminates motion sickness while retaining that classic lo-fi H4S look!

This is achieved by seamlessly blending two different methods for pixelating graphics:
Texture pixelation, used for walls and other level geometry and rendered image pixelation (used for all other objects such as players and level decorations). This last method is what was previously used for all rendering and produced a more "jittery" and choppy image which could cause motion sickness.

You can compare both rendering methods by holding space while unpausing the game to reactivate the old rendering method. Pause and unpause to undo.

Floor Plan Map:
https://i.ibb.co/0hhM35j/Map-Explanation.png
Found somewhere in each level, presumably left behind by some past handyman who must have met their unfortunate demise, is a very useful maintenance schematic that lays out the positions of all repair locations and other important stuff.

This map is best used with the help of a colleague to guide you to the place you need to go. Be careful though sometimes the map may be rotated, making it just a touch harder to navigate.

Variable Flashlight Beam:
https://i.ibb.co/1Kc1fgr/ezgif-4-93c8268b51.gif
Toggle your flashlight on and off to cycle between the two modes:
Long range, narrow beam and short range, wide beam
Use long range to spot repairs in the distance and to look ahead into the darkness. Wide beam mode will come in handy when you're not sure where danger will come from, great for keeping an eye on your surroundings.

3D Skins:
https://i.ibb.co/2SsD1qr/newskins.gif
Blow away your colleagues with your fancy new skins, now with sticky-outty-bits!
Many more 3D skins coming soon!

Here's what's what in update b2.0:
What's New?
New rendering method! Read about it above!
New in-game map! Read about it above!
Variable flashlight! Read about it above!
3D Skins! Read about it above!
Maid dress skin.
Backstabbed skin.
Amazing sax man skin.
Dead face skin.
So Close achievement.

What's Better?
New main menu animation.
Tuned ghost behaviour to be more aggressive.
Added idle sound to broken fuse box.

What's Fixed?
Fixed bug where player flashlight would become inaccessible in doors.
Stability improvements.
Additional minor fixes and improvements.


Please note: the new rendering method is still a work in progress. You may experience visual glitches and other minor issues, I will try my best to resolve these as soon as possible.

I hope you will all enjoy this new update. Some of these changes were due for a while and I'd like to thank everyone for your patience. I happy to see that people are still playing and enjoying the game to this day, that's just the motivation I need. Your support and encouragement means a lot.

Nothing in the game is final, so if you have any suggestions please don't be afraid to get in touch with me via the discord: https://discord.gg/fJWwnSS
I'd love to hear your ideas, if you experience any bugs or if there are things you don't quite like.

As always:
Enjoy, have fun and get spooked!
Ben.

notes.title: Update Beta 1.7
notes.content:
Happy Halloween fellow handymen!
Your spooktastic spooktober is about to get spookier with today new update!
This is our second Halloween update and you're all getting a few new features that have been heavily requested as well as some gameplay improvements and other goodies. 

Here's what's new in this year's Halloween update:
What's New?
New battery reward system! Gain batteries for completing levels. More on this later...
Added region servers! You can now select what region server to connect to! More on this later...
Added Ghost Sock Puppet hat!
Added cleaver hat!
Added Gimp Mask hat!

What's Better?
Up to 5 stickers may now be placed per player.
Server ping and region is now displayed in the pause menu.
Made push to talk on by default.
Increased store prices to balance new reward system.
Renamed Max Player slider to Game Size in the new game options.
Added Jack-O-Lanterns to spooky theme.

What's Fixed?
Fixed bug where endless leaderboard scores were 1 less than achieved.
Fixed bug where batteries could still be deposited in endless mode when the lights were out.
Fixed issue with the slasher animation.
Fixed collision issue with the slasher.
Fixed interactions when typing "E" in chat.
Fixed bug related to sticker placement.
Fixed bug where floorboards could be dropped behind other boards in the repair screen.
Fixed bug where a flashlight dropped onto a floorboard repair could not be picked back up.
Fixed level duplication when host crashed in endless mode.
Fixed bug where the cloning machine could be seen through the ceiling below the attic.


About the new reward system:
Players are now rewarded batteries for successfully completing levels. The amount of batteries gained depends on the game size (set in the new game settings), larger levels = larger payout. Number of players joined, the more players help out with the level, the less batteries you gain. And finally there is a survivor bonus, the more players manage to escape the larger the bonus. The store prices have been increased in order to preserver the difficulty of obtaining items.

About the new server regions: You will only be able to see and join games that are in your same region. Make sure that you and your friends are in the same region when trying to join each other. The region can be selected from the dropdown list in the main menu. Joining via steam should automatically change regions. By default the US East region is connected to, it is strongly advised that you only change this if you experience connection issues such as sudden disconnections and high ping.

I hope you all enjoy this new update and I eagerly wait to hear what you have to say about it! As always, nothing in the game is final, so if you have any suggestions please don't be afraid to get in touch with me via the discord: https://discord.gg/fJWwnSS
I'd love to hear your ideas, know if you experience any bugs or know if there are things you don't quite like.

Enjoy, have fun and I wish you all a SpOoOoOoky Halloween!
Ben.

notes.title: Update Beta 1.6

Greetings fellow handymen!
I've got some spooktacular news for you today. This is probably H4S' biggest update yet! We are so close to 1.0 launch!

This update brings a much requested feature: proximity voice chat! It's been a long time coming but it's finally here. And much more. I hope you all enjoy what's new in beta 1.6.

So without further delay, here's what's new in update b1.6:
What's New?
Proximity Voice Chat! You can scream, but will anyone be near enough to hear you?
New Horrifying Enemy! Can you handle the slasher? May spawn instead of the regular ghost.
Glowsticks! Drop them to help you find your way around. Use them wisely, you don't have many.
Stickers! Find rare sticker capsules scattered in some levels, collect them all!
Secret Attic! That's right, there's an attic in the attic.

What's Better?
Huge performance improvements.
Revamped ghost sound effects.
Shop model spin can now be stopped by clicking on it.
Player selected for the PvP ghost is now announced.
Improved the control scheme menu.
Changed how endless mode leaderboards are updated. Updates after each floor only for living players.
Added new paintings.
Text chat is now available in the end screen.

What's Fixed?
Fixed rendering issue with player models and flashlights.
Fixed room variations always spawning in the same pattern.
Fixed buggy flashlight physics in the elevator.
Fixed issue where decorations would not appear in the attic.

Additional minor fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Update Beta 1.5
notes.content:
Wow, It's been a whole year since the early access release of H4S!
How time flies, huh? I never thought so many people would play the game, let alone love it as much as you guys do. Since the launch of the game we've had over 18,000 new players, utterly mind blowing! I originally developed H4S as a more developed version of a prototype game I had made about 4 years ago for me and my friends to enjoy. After seeing how much fun the game was to play I thought I'd share what I had made with the world, the rest is history!

Thank you to everyone who's given my little spooky game a chance and played it. If it weren't for you I probably would have just published the game and moved on with my life. But instead I get to work on something I love for people who love it, and I'm incredibly honoured to be able to do that. I will keep working on H4S for as long as I can. I fully intend to have a 1.0 launch in the very near future, no longer an early access game but a fully featured indie game. But for us to get to that point we're going to need a few more updates...

So let's see what's new in this one:

Hardcore Mode! Think you can handle huge levels with no respawning, stunning or radar?
Shop in the elevator! Browse and shop from the comfort of the elevator.
Player color can now be adjusted in the shop.
Increased ghost's player detection range for added difficulty.
Improved ghost's path-finding.
Added 1 Year Anniversary theme and hat!
Added 10 battery bonus for players.
Added additional light effects to the elevator.
Added server info to the pause menu.
Added tooltips for certain menu options.
Huge optimisations. Better performance in larger levels.
Other Minor Bug Fixes and changes.


With the release of this update we are now in the BETA phase of development. The core of the game is now mostly finalised and this new stage of development will be focused on preparing the game for a 1.0 release. That means more bugfixing, more polish and more spooky!

Nothing in the game is final, so if you have any suggestions please don't be afraid to get in touch with me via the discord: https://discord.gg/fJWwnSS
I'd love to hear your ideas, know if you experience any bugs or know if there are things you don't quite like.

I hope you enjoy this new update. Thank you to the members of the Discord who suggested some of these changes and for their endless support. Here's to many more anniversary updates!

As always:
Enjoy, have fun, get spooked and thanks for playing!
Ben.

notes.title: Update Alpha 1.3
notes.content:
It's finally here!
Welcome to H4S' second major update: 1.3
This update brings a whole bunch of new features, mechanics, new items and balancing adjustments. Bringing us one big step closer to leaving early access.

The most exiting new mechanic this update is the new repairs. We're no longer just electricians, we're handy men, we fix everything. From burnt fuses, to leaky pipes, to broken floorboards. Whatever your haunted house needs may be, Handy Harry's repair men can get it done!

But that's not all, check out all these other changes:
New repair types! We can fix anything!
Interactable repairs! Perform the repairs yourself, it's about time you did some actual work!
Added task radar! Found in levels, use this to locate needed repairs.
New hats and skins! As if you didn't look great already!
Players can be stunned! Take care when supercharging your flashlight, don't blind your colleagues.
Balanced PVP mode!
Limited ghost wallhacking ability until master switch is flipped.
Limited ghost sprinting until master switch is flipped.
Fixed ghost collision detection.
Endless mode now has a fixed level size regardless of player count.
Updated how to play page to reflect new mechanics.
Optimised lighting.
Added new level decorations.
Added new shop bonus for players.
Added subtle ghost animations.
Added ghostling death animation.
Added new welcome messages for joining players.
Removed ability to disable AI jump scares in the options menu.
Animated and coloured some main menu UI elements.
Fixed issue where doors could sometimes overlap and be unusable.
Fixed issue where players would see a slightly different endscreen time.
Fixed players floating when typing in chat.
Fixed actions happening in game while typing in chat.
Fixed some spelling mistakes.
Many more minor tweaks and fixes


Unfortunately because of the big changes to gameplay and difficulty the leaderboards have been reset in order to keep things fair.

This update has been a long time coming and is by no means the last one, not by a long way. In the future updates will be smaller and more frequent, while these large updates are fun to launch, it means that players need to wait a long time for new features and fixes. So for that reason I will be focusing on more direct updates, meaning new features will be released as they are completed rather than bundled together and launched together.

Nothing in the game is final, so if you have any suggestions please don't be afraid to get in touch with me via the discord: https://discord.gg/fJWwnSS
I'd love to hear your ideas, know if you experience any bugs or know if there are things you don't quite like.

notes.title: Update Alpha 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello! I wanted first thank everyone for your support and feedback on the game. It's been amazing seeing how much you've all been enjoying the game. As a little thank you gift for you guys I've given all players a bonus 25 batteries that you can spend at the shop. With that said, let's get into what's new in this first post-release update: 


Procedural Jumpscares: More on this later...
Ghost is more aggressive towards those who get too close.
Ghost now has a smoke trail.
Ghost will chase the last surviving player relentlessly.
The game log now will have different colors depending on what kind of event is happening.
New players will be prompted to look at the "How to Play" page before joining their fist game.
Added new cosmetic items: Cloning goo skin and face.
Fixed bug where players could not quit to menu after a game.
Fixed a bug where players who got disconnected would end up in limbo and need to restart the game.
Fixed a bug where sometimes special rooms would spawn on top of each other.
Fixed a bug where a special room's rotation was not synchronized across clients.
Fixed the "Amateurs" achievement.
Added a prompt to drop a player's flashlight to the UI.


Now, let's talk about the procedural jumpscares:
Every jumpscare, the spooky face and the sound of screaming, is now procedurally generated by AI. This means that every single jumpscare is entirely unique. Of course this being AI, it's not perfect, sometimes the spooky faces aren't quite spooky enough, but I think it's good enough to merit being a unique game feature that I haven't seen anywhere else.

As usual I look forward to hearing from you guys, keep those community discussions going! It really helps me a ton. And also regarding community, I've decided to create a discord channel where you guys can discuss the game as well as keep me informed of any bugs you might encounter but most importantly I want to hear what ideas you guys have! So go ahead and join via the link below, I look forward to chatting to you guys on the regular!

https://discord.gg/fJWwnSS

Sincerely,
Ben.

notes.title: Early Access Release!
notes.content:

As for this update here is what's new:

NEW PVP MODE!!!
New character customization: Head and body skins.
Message of the day panel.
Loads of bug fixes and minor tweaks.


The new PvP mode is still experimental but I thought it would be nice to release it along with the release of the game. Simply start a game and select the PvP option. Once the game starts, one player will be chosen to be the ghost. The ghost can see in the dark as well as other player's flashlights through walls (but only if that player has their flashlight on). The ghost can also right click to teleport to a random part of the map. This part of the game is still in an early stage, expect bugs, and it's subject to changes.

I hope you enjoy the new update.
